Title: Goat Child of Cosmic Balance and Blood

Category: Seen Gods

Primarily Practiced in: Zaho, small pockets worldwide

Espirian Domains: The Hells (Solum, Arcanum, Neferium, Perditum, Obscurum, Mortum and Somnum)

Among the Sophic Siblings, Azoph-met is the one most known to many in Ardor. It is said that he was the one who created the azoph-fer, and their souls are forever bound to him so that they will return to him. As the prime inheritor of Bapho-met’s seat, Azoph-met ruled Zaho and his fellow siblings for centuries before the conflicts between them and their followers reached a fever pitch. Even so, many men and spirits in Zaho still revere and seek to meet their lord’s goals. Fiends of all forms in all the hells worship and report to Azoph-met and undermine those that follow the other siblings, and worshippers in the material plane fight on Zaho and spread the word of the cosmic balance worldwide.

 

To Azophists, order must be upended, and chaos must be reined in; and in the process of these seemingly antagonistic ends, conflict will arise and be perpetual, and thus the Strife continues. Toppling existing order attracts those filled with hate and rage at the state of the world, while those who wish to fight to bring an end to rampant chaos draws those who want to bring an end to suffering. These edicts draw plenty of would-be revolutionaries who are willing to bargain with devils or borrow untold power drawn from the blood of sacrifices in the name of their cause.

 

Edicts Upheave order and cause war in times of peace; conquer and subdue in times of strife

Anathema Cause irrevocable destruction or subjugation, be timid before a chance to leave a lasting impression for your cause

Areas of Concern Balance, Chaos, Order

Religious Symbol A severed goat’s head

Sacred Animal Goat

Sacred Colors red and black
